The guide overview lists50EC under the60EC foundation heading and135EC under the120EC advanced heading; its detailed timetable confirms all60foundationEC but does not resolve the advanced allocation. Available programme-specific OER/implementation rules are explicitly2025–2026 and allocate15EC to the restricted-choice block, versus30EC in the current guide. Those historical links are retained internally and excluded from additional current programme sources. The verified75EC subset is preserved; no inferred correction to180EC. The current CB9806 course page confirms its entry condition.

componentNotes.graduation: This 15 EC research project is an alternative to the thesis practicum. To enter, no more than two bachelor courses may remain, and you must already be enrolled in them; free-space courses are exempt from this condition. You choose a research question with your supervisor within one of the programme’s four thematic topics.
